rollback: Keep the current main release; do not deploy this candidate before acceptance.

song_import_gameplay.evidence: Automated original practice audio and generated-song import checks are separate from audible timing and physical acceptance. Strum-held sustains, feedback sound levels and the song volume response are not yet playtested by a person on real guitars.

controller_hardware.evidence: Requires physical supported guitar/MIDI input testing in Backstage. Two PDP Riffmaster (Xbox) receivers are attached to the development Mac and were detected read-only; no reader was started against them by the agent. Controller stability (presence, release, reconnect, stale-reader stop, quit release) is not yet tested on real receivers; on 2026-10-11 stale MacRiff root readers held them and a dev session aborted in libusb_close on quit (fixed in this candidate, unverified on hardware).

clean_install.evidence: Requires the built game on a clean target machine.

recovery.evidence: Requires game and device disconnect/reconnect testing.
